inputs.rule: fit of cost-20261025T060213Z at 1, 4 and 16 tables (cas_startup_requests_base, cas_startup_error_requests_base, cas_startup_requests_per_table, cas_startup_error_requests_per_table): 2xx GET 17 + 11 per table, PUT 7 + 2 per table, LIST 2 + 5 per table, HEAD 3, DELETE 2; 4xx GET 1 + 3 per table, PUT 2, HEAD 3, DELETE 1; plus 1 GET per Compact part and 1 GET per log record (3 per part)

PutObject.reason: one mount lease renewal may fall inside the window

source_refs.claim: part load reads columns, checksums, granularity, index and rows
a Wide part's index granularity is loaded from its first column's marks file (a blob); a Compact part's data.cmrk4 is inline
an inline file is served from the manifest bytes and sends no request
a table's refs are recovered by replaying its durable log: one GET per log record since the last snapshot
the disk access check writes, reads and removes a probe file at startup
the mount lease renews every 10 s with one PutObject: a renewal can fall inside the window
